description: NIST's FTC-11, its AP242 edition 2's solid #1299 alone (excerpted with tools/oracle/excerpt.py): the convex edge between the plane f0 and the cylinder f39, written as a cubic B-spline of one span that hides a circle (r 0.2151, within 9.7e-5 of the faces' own section, the edge's tolerance 2.5e-3), its ends each a vertex of three edges with a plane across (f38, f40). Filleted alone at the battery's radius. Arris refuses it Unsupported(NURBS curve × plane surface); Open CASCADE builds it (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 1). The desired result matches Open CASCADE's
